papers.title: The genetic and proteomic determinants of pediatric stature development and their link to adult height and type 2 diabetes
papers.abstract: Childhood growth reflects complex genetic and biological processes, but their developmental timing is not fully understood. Here, the authors identify stage‑specific genetic and proteomic influences on growth from infancy through childhood, and reveal links between early growth patterns and later type 2 diabetes risk.
papers.titleZh: 兒童身高發育的基因與蛋白體決定因子及其與成人身高及第二型糖尿病的關聯
papers.summaryZh: 本研究探討兒童生長背後的複雜基因與生物過程，並關注其發育時序。作者指出從嬰兒期到兒童期的生長受到階段特異性的基因與蛋白體影響。研究亦揭示早期生長模式與成年後第二型糖尿病風險之間存在關聯。

papers.title: A quantitative deep-learning-based framework reveals a continuum of chromatin sensitivities across transcription factors
papers.abstract: The authors develop a deep-learning-based framework revealing that TF binding sensitivity to chromatin is a continuum rather than a binary feature, and that binding patterns can be explained by a mixture of hierarchical and cooperative mechanisms.
papers.titleZh: 深度學習框架揭示轉錄因子對染色質敏感度的連續性
papers.summaryZh: 作者開發了一套基於深度學習的定量框架，用於分析轉錄因子結合與染色質的關係。研究顯示，轉錄因子對染色質的結合敏感度並非二元特徵，而是呈現連續分布。結合模式可由階層式與合作式機制混合解釋。該框架提供量化評估轉錄因子染色質敏感度的方法。結果提示轉錄因子結合的調控可能比傳統二元觀點更為複雜。

papers.title: Benzoxaboroles target CPSF3 for degradation through a SUMO-dependent pathway in trypanosomes
papers.abstract: Benzoxaborole drugs, such as acoziborole, target CPSF3 and mRNA processing in multiple parasites. Here the authors find that these drugs rapidly and specifically target trypanosome CPSF3 for degradation, in a SUMO- and proteasome-dependent manner.
papers.titleZh: 苯并氧硼杂环类药物经SUMO依赖途径降解锥虫CPSF3
papers.summaryZh: 苯并氧硼杂环类药物如acoziborole已知可靶向多种寄生虫的CPSF3并影响mRNA加工。本研究发现，这些药物能快速且特异性地使锥虫CPSF3发生降解。降解过程依赖SUMO化以及蛋白酶体。该结果揭示了苯并氧硼杂环类药物在锥虫中作用的降解机制。

papers.title: Foliar and floral frost damage reshape reproductive phenology with limited carry-over effects
papers.abstract: Late spring frost can damage plant tissues and disrupt reproduction. The authors show that frost damage to leaves shortens the fruit development period, whereas damage to flowers prolongs it, with limited carry-over effects into the following year.
papers.titleZh: 葉部與花部霜害重塑繁殖物候，隔年延續效應有限
papers.summaryZh: 晚春霜凍可能傷害植物組織並干擾繁殖。作者顯示，霜害發生在葉部會縮短果實發育期，而霜害發生在花部則會延長果實發育期。兩種霜害對繁殖物候的影響方向不同。研究指出此類影響對隔年的延續效應有限。結果顯示霜害部位會決定繁殖時程的調整方式。

papers.title: Chronically stable, frequency-selective auditory brainstem stimulation via ultra-flexible penetrating electrode arrays
papers.abstract: Surface auditory brainstem implants have poor spatial resolution and limited tonotopic access. Here, the authors develop a high-density, ultra-flexible penetrating array for frequency-selective cochlear nucleus stimulation and use-dependent plasticity in downstream auditory circuits.
papers.titleZh: 以超柔性穿透電極陣列進行慢性穩定、頻率選擇性聽覺腦幹刺激
papers.summaryZh: 本研究指出，現有的表面式聽覺腦幹植入物具有較差的空間解析度且對位音圖的存取有限。作者開發了一種高密度、超柔性的穿透式陣列，用於頻率選擇性刺激耳蝸核。該陣列被用於探討下游聽覺迴路中的使用依賴性可塑性。研究聚焦於慢性穩定的腦幹刺激方法與頻率選擇性刺激的可行性。

papers.title: Desmin filaments extend along actin filaments within the mouse skeletal muscle sarcomere
papers.abstract: Here, the authors use super-resolution microscopy to show that desmin filaments extend beyond Z-lines and align with actin inside mouse skeletal muscle sarcomeres, where they help support force generation when sarcomeres are stretched.
papers.titleZh: Desmin 纖維在小鼠骨骼肌肌節內沿肌動蛋白延伸
papers.summaryZh: 本研究以超解析顯微鏡觀察小鼠骨骼肌，發現 Desmin 纖維會超出 Z 線延伸，並在肌節內與肌動蛋白對齊。作者指出 Desmin 纖維並非僅侷限於 Z 線周圍，而是沿著肌動蛋白纖維分布於肌節內部。該分布模式顯示 Desmin 在肌節結構中具有更廣泛的定位。研究進一步指出，此種排列有助於在肌節被拉伸時支持力量產生。

paper.title: Electrically induced glass transition of polyelectrolyte complexes enables kinetic ionic diodes
paper.abstract: The glass transition induces changes in material properties, transforming a rigid glass into a soft rubber. Here the authors demonstrate an electrically induced glass transition in a polyelectrolyte complex, sandwiched between two oppositely charged ionoelastomers and applying time-temperature-salt superposition principle.

paper.title: Denitrogenative glycosylations of glycosyl sulfonohydrazides
paper.abstract: Despite notable progress, the development of novel and efficient glycosyl radical precursors that are readily accessible, synthetically versatile, and compatible with stereoselective coupling platforms remains an ongoing challenge. Here the authors report a nickel-catalysed stereoselective denitrogenative glycosylation of redox-neutral glycosyl sulfonohydrazides via anomeric C–N bond homolysis.
